title: SimEngine v3 Domain Config
description: Machine-readable contract for a SimEngine v3 domain configuration. Mirrors the engine's validate_config / DomainConfig / kernel rules exactly. Required at the top level: name, n_steps, step_logic, metrics, and AT LEAST ONE non-empty variable category (parameters, controls, exogenous, or variables). All other fields are optional; DomainConfig supplies defaults the validator does not enforce. Expression strings are intentionally under-constrained here because the engine performs its own static name-resolution and a live 10-iteration test run during validation.

name.description: Domain name. Required: validate_config rejects a falsy/empty value ('Missing name field'). DomainConfig defaults to 'unnamed' but validation makes it mandatory.

n_steps.description: Number of simulation steps along the time axis. Must be a positive integer ('n_steps must be a positive integer'). DomainConfig default is 12 but validation requires it present and valid.

n_simulations.description: Monte Carlo run count. DomainConfig default 5000. Not enforced by validate_config.

resolve_by.description: Optional ISO date when a binary forecast for this domain can be graded (e.g. '2026-06-30'). Pre-fills the Track-this-forecast form; not enforced by the engine.

seed.description: Random seed. May be null. DomainConfig default None.

metrics.description: Required, non-empty map of metricName -> Metric. ('Missing metrics' if absent or empty.) Each metric's expr is evaluated by the kernel and its statistics ({metric}_{stat}) are referenced by fitness components.

step_logic.description: Required, non-empty ordered list of per-step update rules ('Missing step_logic'). Each item targets a state name and provides either an expr or an inline sample. If both are present the kernel uses expr.

parameters.description: Variable category: uncertain inputs. Map of name -> Variable. Counts toward the at-least-one-category requirement when non-empty.

controls.description: Variable category: operator/decision levers (often tunable). Map of name -> Variable. Counts toward the at-least-one-category requirement when non-empty.

exogenous.description: Variable category: external shocks outside operator control. Map of name -> Variable. Counts toward the at-least-one-category requirement when non-empty.

variables.description: Legacy/backward-compat variable category, still accepted: validate_config counts it toward the required variable categories, and DomainConfig merges it into parameters when parameters is empty. Prefer parameters/controls/exogenous for new configs.

initial_state.description: Starting numeric values for accumulators / step targets. Map of name -> number. These names become valid references in expressions.

accumulators.description: Map of accumulatorName -> expression string, evaluated each step (running totals). Auto-initialized to 0.0 if not present in initial_state. Each value MUST be an expression string.

safety.description: Optional safety constraints. Not structurally validated by validate_config; consumed by evaluate_safety.

fitness.description: Optimizer objective. compute_fitness sums weight * eval(expr) over components. Component exprs reference metric statistics as '{metricName}_{stat}' where stat is one of mean, median, std, p10, p25, p75, p90.

expr.description: Expression over metric statistics, e.g. 'total_revenue_median - 0.5 * cost_p90'.

weight.description: Multiplier for this component. Defaults to 1.0 (comp.get('weight', 1.0)).

name.description: Optional human-readable label for the component.

tunable.description: List of config paths the optimizer may mutate. Each path is split on '.' to walk into the config dict.

path.description: Dot-separated path into the config, e.g. 'controls.monthly_budget.params.value'.

integer.description: If true, the optimizer rounds this lever to a whole number (e.g. number of staff). Default false.

step.description: Optional grid spacing; the optimizer snaps this lever to multiples of step (measured from range[0]).

correlations.description: v3.1 feature. Pairwise correlations between variables. Builds a correlation matrix + Cholesky factor; only entries with exactly two vars present in the matrix are applied. Presence of this field disables the native batch sampler.

vars.description: The two variable names to correlate. Only len==2 entries are applied.

rho.description: Correlation coefficient. Defaults to 0 if missing. Typically in [-1, 1].

calibration.description: Top-level calibration metadata (DomainConfig reads data.get('calibration')). In practice calibration is usually attached PER-VARIABLE inside each variable def rather than here.

context.description: Optional metadata (decision question, key levers, etc.). Passed through in API responses; not read by DomainConfig or validate_config.

_guide.description: Documentation-only field present in _template.json (schema/distribution/expression/safety hints). Ignored by the engine.

Variable.description: A variable definition (used in parameters / controls / exogenous / variables, and as an inline step_logic 'sample'). Requires a 'distribution' from the SAMPLERS registry and a non-empty 'params' object. params values may be numeric literals OR a string starting with '$' (a late-binding reference resolved to state.get(name, 0) at sample time).

distribution.description: One of the SAMPLERS registry keys. Note: 'correlated_normal' from the README table is NOT a registered sampler and would be rejected as an unknown distribution; use the top-level 'correlations' array instead.

params.description: Distribution parameters. Required and non-empty ('missing params'). Per-distribution required/optional keys are enforced by the allOf/if-then rules on this Variable. Each value is a number or a '$name' late-binding reference string.

oneOf.description: Late-binding reference, e.g. '$current_price'. Resolved to state.get('current_price', 0) at sample time.
List-valued param: 'values' / 'probs' for categorical and empirical.

calibration.description: Optional per-variable calibration metadata (e.g. observed data, posterior bookkeeping). Not structurally validated by validate_config.

params.description: student_t has NO strictly-required params; all have kernel defaults (df=5, mean=0, scale=1) and optional clamps (min, max). 'params' itself must still be a non-empty object per validate_config.
Beta(alpha, beta), optionally rescaled to [low, high] (defaults 0..1).
Discrete outcome drawn from 'values' with optional 'probs' (same length; normalized; uniform when absent).
Bootstrap from observed 'values'; optional gaussian 'jitter' (a std) for a smoothed bootstrap.

StepLogicItem.description: One per-step update rule. Requires a truthy 'target' state name and EXACTLY ONE OF 'expr' or 'sample'. ('step_logic[i]: missing target' / 'step_logic[i]: missing expr or sample'.) If both are supplied the kernel evaluates 'expr' (it checks 'expr' first).

target.description: State name to assign each step. Becomes a valid expression reference.

expr.description: Expression string evaluated each step to produce the target's value. Allowed names: SAFE_BUILTINS, True/False/None, _step, all variable names, accumulator names, initial_state keys, and step_logic targets. No lambdas, comprehensions, or dotted attribute access.

sample.description: Inline variable definition sampled each step (alternative to expr).

Metric.description: A reported output metric. The kernel evaluates eval_expr(expr); statistics ({metric}_{stat}) are derived for fitness and reporting.

expr.description: Expression string evaluated to produce the metric value (subject to the same expression name rules as step_logic).

format.description: Display format hint used by the UI/printer. Defaults to 'number' in _metric_formats.

ChanceConstraint.description: Probabilistic constraint on a metric. All four keys are accessed directly (no .get) in _evaluate_safety_python, so they are effectively required when the constraint is present. Below-style conditions count outcomes v < threshold; above-style count v > threshold; an unrecognized keyword raises ValueError at evaluation time (fail-loud, never silently inverted).

metric.description: Name of the metric to evaluate.

condition.description: Below-style aliases (below/lt/</less_than/under/lte/<=) count v < threshold; above-style (above/gt/>/greater_than/exceeds/gte/>=) count v > threshold. Mirrors kernel.py BELOW_CONDITIONS/ABOVE_CONDITIONS.

max_prob.description: Maximum allowed probability of violating the threshold (0..1).

CvarConstraint.description: Conditional Value-at-Risk constraint. metric/alpha/min_cvar are accessed directly (effectively required). CVaR = mean of the worst (lowest) alpha-fraction of outcomes; passes if actual_cvar >= min_cvar.

metric.description: Name of the metric to evaluate.

alpha.description: Tail fraction, e.g. 0.10 for the worst 10% of outcomes.

min_cvar.description: Minimum acceptable CVaR; the constraint passes when actual_cvar >= min_cvar.
